description: Search BeautySpark's makeup and colour-season guides for sections that answer a question, e.g. eyeliner for hooded eyes or how to find your undertone. Returns up to 5 sections with a short snippet and a link; read one in full with get_guide. Cite the returned url. When nothing matches, the result has a note saying no BeautySpark guide covers it.

limit.description: Results to return, 1 to 5. Defaults to 5.

locale.description: The user's language as a language tag, e.g. "de" or "pt-BR". Set it from the user's language. Defaults to English.

query.description: Keywords for the makeup or colour question, e.g. "eyeliner hooded eyes".

season.description: Color season, e.g. "True Winter" or "true_winter". One of the 12 seasons.

name: search_guides
title: Search BeautySpark guides
